multiplechoiceresponse.p: You are handed a raw extract and asked to clean it. The correct first step is:

choice.div: Keep the original untouched and profile it — row counts, blanks, distinct values.
Delete every row with an empty cell.
Sort it by the first column and start editing in place.

div.p: Cleaning is a re-runnable recipe. Preserve the raw file, look before you touch, and record what you change.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A region column contains "UK", "U.K.", "United Kingdom" and "uk". This is a problem of:

choice.div: Consistency — the same thing written several ways.

div.p: Standardise to one code. Note that the same value text can mean different things in different contexts, so confirm the mapping before merging.

choiceresponse.p: Which statements about missing values are true? Select all that apply.

choice.div: An empty cell, a zero, and "unknown" can mean three different things.
How you handle missing values should be documented.
Averaging the numeric columns is always a valid fix.
Dropping rows can bias the result if the missingness is not random.

div.p: Missingness carries meaning. Deciding how to treat it is an analytical judgement, so it must be recorded — and the reason it is missing often matters more than the gap itself.
